content.title: 3 top stock picks in the lifestyle brand space
content.description:
There is some opportunity for investors in lifestyle brands, but they need to be selective.

Stifel sports and lifestyle brands analyst Peter McGoldrick joins Market Domination Overtime host Josh Lipton to share some of his top stock picks in the space: On Holding (ONON), Levi Strauss & Co. (LEVI), and Wolverine World Wide (WWW).

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.
